name: general-name-empty-context-tag-invalid
description: permittedSubtrees with a zero-length context-specific GeneralName ([2] IMPLICIT IA5String, 0 bytes) should be rejected at GeneralName decode time on validators that treat empty IA5 as malformed.
notes: Raw DER: NC SEQUENCE { permitted [0] { GeneralSubtree { base [2] '' } } }. See empty-dns-* corpus entries for the policy fork.
